title: Orange et moi Sénégal
meta_description: The free mobile account management application.
full_description: Orange and I is a free application for Orange Senegal customers that allows you to:- Manage your mobile account (recharge the account, check the balance, buy an Internet pass, sign up for offers, change offers ...)- Access to SOS credit and Internet Pass solutions- Contact an Orange expert at any time thanks to the online support section- Take advantage of Orange's services and applications- Find all the assistance you need (Frequently asked questions, customer service number, address of Orange shops ...)From now on, you will not have to remember the access codes for the various services!-------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------Conditions:- Use: the Orange and Me application is accessible to Orange Senegal customers under Orange mobile network coverage or with Wifi.- Download: possible Wifi and free, under Orange mobile network coverage: download costs are included or discounted according to your offer.- Costs: navigation in the app is free on the Orange Senegal network (excluding roaming and location of agencies and Orange shops on a map).- The application Orange and me you like? Feel free to write a review on the Store!-------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------Questions or comments?
